name: Gyosukui
source:
He looks like he plays as a bassist in some band.
[spoiler]Died by Chris Kanu's strong strike (he didn't die immediately though).[/spoiler]
His name comes from "Kingyousukui" (that activity with scooping goldfishes during festivals).
Works for the Maya Union and was former assassination target 104.
